description:
MISHEK is a Guatemalan team built around computational civil engineering: the idea that infrastructure problems — on Earth or on Mars — are solved faster when engineering judgment meets data and code.

Christell García (project lead) is a third-year Civil Engineering student at Universidad del Valle de Guatemala.

The team is completed by  Ian Castellanos a final-year Applied Mathematics student.

"In a new place: where can a human safely walk on Mars? "
